creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`View::of` grew an eighth argument during a_2HrmSyRAQ and clippy refused it, which forced the per-pane four into one closure returning a ViewPane. That was the right shape and the reason is worth keeping: two of the four returned `Option<String>`, so a caller that swapped them compiled and pointed every pane's bridge at the wrong thing.

Three positional closures remain - a mirror, a transport and a backend socket - and two of those two are per-daemon and differently typed, so the same hazard is not there. This is a note rather than a defect: if a fourth per-daemon answer ever arrives, group them the same way rather than adding a sixth argument.

Low priority. Nothing is wrong today.
title: 🧹 View::of takes four closures where a reader can check two
